clues.text: Naomi and Ruth arrived in Bethlehem from Moab just as the barley season of this was beginning.
When Israel asked for a king, Samuel called on the LORD to send thunder and rain during the wheat season of this.
Solomon told the slacker to learn from the ant, which gathers its food at the time of this.
Joseph advised Pharaoh to take a fifth of this in Egypt during the seven years of abundance.
Moved by the helpless crowds, Jesus told His disciples this is plentiful, but the workers are few.
God told Israel that when gathering this, they must leave the field's edges and gleanings for the poor.
In the parable of the weeds, Jesus said this stands for the end of the age.
